Union Strong!

It was an honor to join our hardworking Nurses and clinicians from @MassNurses on the picket line this morning to demand that Mass General/Brigham Hospital return to the bargaining table and reach a fair and equitable contract with the MNA. My thanks to @RepRichardNeal, @EdforBoston, Democratic nominee for Congress @dank, and MNA leadership for fighting for affordable and reliable health care for all. 

Our nurses and clinicians are the heart and soul of our healthcare system - they are always there for us, and I’m proud to stand in solidarity with them!
